description: This file contains utility functions and constants related to color handling in the Notesnook mobile app, including color definitions, color shading, status bar updates, and color format conversions.

methods.name: getContainerBorder
methods.description: Generates border style object with specified color, width, and shade based on theme.

methods.name: getColorLinearShade
methods.description: Returns a shaded RGBA color based on input color, alpha, and theme darkness.

methods.name: updateStatusBarColor
methods.description: Updates the status bar style and background color based on theme and platform.

methods.name: hexToRGBA
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGBA string, optionally with specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: RGB_Linear_Shade
methods.description: Returns a color shade by lightening or darkening an RGBA color based on parameter p.
